provenance.tool: tests/reference/derive_models.py (Python 3.13 standard library: fractions, decimal, random)
provenance.steps: For each point of points.csv at the parameter set of parameters.csv: raw = [c_min + (c_max - c_min) x exp(-b x (1 - pool factor)) x 1 / (1 + exp(-k x (I - x0)))] x min(1, age / a_ramp) (1 when a_ramp = 0) x Season(month of as_of_date); CPR = min(1, max(0, raw)); SMM = 1 - exp(ln(1 - CPR) / 12), 1 at CPR = 1. Decimal arithmetic at 50 significant digits in derive_models.Model, which shares no code with models.py; rounded to 20 significant digits. Set A exercises seasoning below, at and above a_ramp, age 0 and burnout; set B a_ramp = 0 and b = 0; set C the upper clamp (C1, C4) next to unclamped points; set D |k (I - x0)| = 1000, where a naive logistic overflows. Not covered: the lower clamp max(0, .), reachable only with a negative season factor, which the contract neither allows nor forbids.
